error_events.evidence: Planner asked policy_checker only 'Check if the cancellation of flights for reservation ID SI5UKW is allowed under the airline's policy', dropping the facts db_agent had just reported at step 4 ('Cabin: basic_economy', 'Created At: 2024-05-11T00:08:57', 'Insurance: no'). policy_checker answered at step 7 'VERDICT: need_info — The user ID and reason for cancellation are requir...' and listed booking date, cabin class and insurance status as missing. The planner only supplied those values at step 17.

The customer said at step 9 'My user ID is amelia_rossi_1297' and get_reservation_details had returned "user_id": "amelia_rossi_1297" (step 3 tool result, restated in db_agent's step 4 report). The planner's instruction to policy_checker says 'with user ID amelia_rossi_1247'. The corrupted id was then restated by policy_checker at steps 11, 13 and 18 and re-emitted by the planner at step 17; it was never corrected. It happened to be inert because no lookup used it (all db calls keyed on reservation SI5UKW).

Planner told the customer 'Your case has been escalated to a supervisor for review, and your contact information has been provided. They will be in touch with you directly' (after promising the same at step 27). The planner's tools are read_file, write_file, policy_checker, db_agent, respond_to_user — there is no escalation/transfer action, the only thing done was write_file to /case_notes.md at step 29, and the policy contains no supervisor-callback procedure ('You should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools'). No record supports a supervisor having received the case or the contact details.
